veranderings.blok: Geslaan: die ngoma van die VhaVenda
veranderings.voor: met penne om die rand vasgesteek
veranderings.na: met penne rondom die rand vasgesteek
veranderings.rede: 'Rondom' makes clear the pegs go all around the rim; bare 'om' reads abruptly here.

veranderings.na: lywe en instrumente, ook dié wat julle self gemaak het
veranderings.rede: The elliptical adjective 'selfgemaakte' with no noun after it is hard for a Grade 4 reader; a short relative clause says the same thing plainly.
'Eerste begin' is redundant, and 'eerste' is repeated later in the same sentence ('na die eerste keer').

vlae.teks: Een persoon of groep sing of speel 'n kort deel en 'n ander herhaal dit presies.
vlae.rede: By the AWS rule a comma belongs before 'en' here, because ''n ander herhaal' has its own subject and verb. The protected sibling definition of roep-en-antwoord has the same structure without the comma, so adding it to this one alone would make the two parallel definitions differ; left unchanged for a person to decide both together.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected definition 'Een persoon of groep sing of speel 'n kort deel en 'n ander antwoord daarop.' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 rule calls for a comma before 'en'. The same applies to the unprotected 'roep en eggo' definition, which mirrors it.
